scope: Textual front end for the native single-RTX-4090 installer

design.implementation: Native Textual widgets and CSS; heading, labels, cards and step-navigation concepts

verification.command: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/private/tmp uv run --python 3.10 --no-project --with textual==8.2.8 python -m unittest discover -s scripts/onprem -q
checks: Keyboard-only setup and review, inline invalid-email feedback
LAN selection and retained defaults without writing installation state
Preview mode never executes host setup commands
Failure log navigation and return to retained settings
Masked password inputs are cleared; password absent from process arguments
Captured provisioning uses --no-tui and noninteractive stdin/sudo
Successful worker exit also requires a complete recorded installation
Bootstrap shell syntax and embedded Python syntax

privilege_and_authentication.bootstrap: Standard terminal through App.suspend for OS setup, sudo and GitHub authentication
privilege_and_authentication.captured_progress: Noninteractive sudo uses an existing ticket; keepalive does not grant or persist new permissions
privilege_and_authentication.password_setup: Direct own-origin HTTPS request with certificate validation; no argv/env/file/log storage

limitations: A fresh Ubuntu installation, actual interactive sudo/GitHub handoff and physical driver reboot were not exercised through the TUI
Four existing external integration/acceptance tests were skipped
Screen artifacts use preview values; SVG CJK textLength is corrected to terminal cell width
